classification.notes: Effort: Steady prep (1); oven roast with one flip is mostly unattended (0); one whisked glaze is a simple sauce (1); roast technique (0); two sheet pans in one oven with no parallel attended vessel (0, same convention as packets+rice and harissa carrots+couscous). Sum 2 -> easy. Borderline at the easy|moderate edge. Complexity: 8 countable items (0). Hard-contract egg-free/dairy-free gnocchi scored as one widely available contract specialty (1), by parity with the vegetarian-Parmesan precedent, even though most shelf-stable gnocchi already comply. One maple-Dijon-thyme seasoning profile (0). Sourcing mainstream (0). Sum 1 -> simple.
